desc: Ideation/derivation of correct model: per-color cost = max dist to X (merging batches), cross-color sharing = LCS of the two path sequences; verified against all four samples (4, 0, -1, 8).
Parse input; build P and Q arrays; walk X's cycle in each permutation assigning dist (dist(X)=0, dist(c_j)=L−j along walk order).
Feasibility: every i with A_i=1 must be on X's P-cycle, every i with B_i=1 on X's Q-cycle; else print -1.
Compute R = max dist_P over red balls, B = max dist_Q over blue balls; seqP = cycle-walk segment c_{L−R..L−1}, seqQ = c'_{L'−B..L'−1}.
Compute LCS of seqP and seqQ via position-map + LIS (bisect) in O(N log N); answer = R + B − LCS.
Implement full program with fast I/O, 64-bit integers; handle edge cases: no balls (0), balls only at X (0), self-loops, N=2; sanity-check mentally against samples.
